jobs.title: Backend Developer (.NET)
jobs.description: Build and maintain backend services for a recruitment platform. Develop ASP.NET Core REST APIs for job postings, applications and recruiter workflows. Design database transactions, logging and access controls. Collaborate with frontend developers and review code.
jobs.requirements: At least 2 years of backend development. Required: C#, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, Git and REST API design. Understand Entity Framework Core, input validation, authentication, unit testing and query optimization. Docker and Redis are useful additional experience.
jobs.benefits: Khung lương kiểm thử 20–35 triệu/tháng; lịch hybrid, đào tạo kỹ thuật và code review. Không phải lời mời tuyển dụng thực tế.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React / TypeScript)
jobs.description: Develop a responsive recruiter dashboard and candidate application portal. Implement React components, searchable tables, accessible forms, loading states and API error handling. Integrate REST APIs and cooperate with design and backend teams.
jobs.requirements: At least 2 years of frontend development. Required: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Git. Understand responsive layout, keyboard accessibility and component state. Automated frontend tests and performance profiling are desirable.
jobs.benefits: Khung lương kiểm thử 18–32 triệu/tháng; làm từ xa, review thiết kế và đào tạo. Tin dành cho đồ án.

jobs.title: Database Engineer (SQL Server)
jobs.description: Design and operate the recruitment platform database. Create normalized schemas, constraints and indexes. Optimize T-SQL queries, investigate execution plans, implement transaction safety, maintain backup schedules and validate database recovery. Document migrations and access permissions.
jobs.requirements: At least 3 years working with relational databases. Required: SQL, SQL Server, database design and Git. Hands-on query optimization, backup and restore, stored procedures and role-based database access. PostgreSQL and Python are useful additional experience.
jobs.benefits: Khung lương kiểm thử 24–40 triệu/tháng; đào tạo quản trị dữ liệu, môi trường phát triển riêng. Tin dành cho đồ án.

job.benefits: Dữ liệu mẫu lọc việc: làm từ xa, đào tạo vận hành, lương 28–45 triệu tham khảo.
